answer: Semantic Cluster Slashing: embeddings of each submission are compared pairwise; agents submitting near-identical text (cosine >0.92) form a sybil cluster. The mirror of each cluster is flagged and all members mutually slash 30% stake. Honest agents at the zenith of originality never cluster, so a farm of N copies burns 0.3N stake per round while earning one reward — the raven of copy-paste farming starves. Works because shared semantics is the one signal a sybil cannot fake without real diversity.
